faq.q: Why do creator-style AI ads get attention?
faq.a: They open like a recommendation, so the problem and the product show up before a polished brand spot would.

faq.q: What does AI UGC mean for a product ad?
faq.a: It is a creator-style product ad read by an AI actor, not a review from a buyer. Start from your photo or your product page, then read the words before you download.

faq.q: What does a paid plan include before the first ad?
faq.a: Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. A photo is 24 credits. Videos of 6, 10, 15, and 30 seconds cost 24, 40, 60, and 120 credits. You see the charge before you start.

faq.q: How long does an AI UGC ad take?
faq.a: You stay on the page and can edit the line while the file renders, then download it when it finishes. A failed job returns the credits.

faq.q: How do I make a UGC ad with an AI actor?
faq.a: Upload a product photo or paste a page link, pick an AI actor, and read the script. Change the line if it does not fit, then generate.

faq.q: Where do the AI actors for these ads come from?
faq.a: They come from a library of 53 adult AI actors. Pick a face that fits the buyer, then pair it with a voice from the same library.

faq.q: Can I turn a product link into a UGC ad?
faq.a: Yes. Paste a public product page so the tool can start from the product image and the name. Add who the ad is for before you review it.

faq.q: Do these AI UGC ads need a signed release?
faq.a: No signed release is needed for an AIVideosUGC AI actor, and the file is cleared for commercial use with no watermark. You still need rights to the product photo and to any voice sample you upload.

faq.q: Can I change the ad after it is generated?
faq.a: Yes. Edit the script, swap the face, change the captions, and render another version. The credit charge shows before you confirm that next job.

faq.q: How is a customer video different from AI UGC?
faq.a: A customer video is filmed by a person who bought the product. An AI actor ad uses a generated face and a line you approved. Do not present it as a review from a buyer.

faq.q: Should I use an AI actor or hire a person?
faq.a: Use an AI actor when you need the ad without a shoot, or several versions to test. Hire a person when a real founder has to be the one on camera.

faq.q: Can I make the same ad in another language?
faq.a: Yes. Write the product sentence in the language you sell in, then pick a voice that matches it. Render the same offer again for the next market.

faq.q: Which languages can the spoken line use?
faq.a: Any language you can write the product sentence in. Pick a voice that matches it. The same offer can be cut for TikTok and for Meta.

faq.q: Where do I get help before a promotion date?
faq.a: Email support@aivideosugc.com with the product page and the line you want spoken. We help you get the script right before that date.

faq.q: Can an AI actor use a voice we already recorded?
faq.a: Yes. An AI actor can use a cloned voice when you have rights to the sample. Upload only audio you own or are allowed to use.

faq.q: Can I post creator-style ads without hiring anyone?
faq.a: Yes. Start from your product photo and an AI actor, then publish the download in your ad account like any other video.

faq.q: Can I make a testimonial-style ad for TikTok?
faq.a: Yes. Make a vertical testimonial-style ad with an AI actor, approve the line, and download it for TikTok. Check that platform's label rules before you post.

faq.q: What should a small shop look for in a UGC tool?
faq.a: A tool that shows the credit cost first and lets you approve the script. It should export 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4 with no watermark. Failed jobs return credits. You can send up to 7 reference images with a job.

limitations.h2: What to Check Before You Post

items.d: Add the real size and fit notes so buyers are not guessing from the picture.
Photograph ports, seams, or the back yourself when the upload hides them.

items.t: Keep Claims You Can Stand Behind
items.d: Only post a demo that matches a test you already ran.
Read the caption, the price, and the offer in the editor, then post the ad.
Compare the file with the product you ship, then post the one that matches.

more_sections.h2: One Place for the Whole UGC Ad
more_sections.lead: You get the shots, the language, the delivery, the edit, and the captions in the same file.

items.d: A plain product photo can move in a clip. Match the color to the photo you uploaded before anyone posts it.

items.t: Write the Ad in Their Language
items.d: Write the sentence in the language you sell in, then pick a voice that matches it. No translation vendor has to sit in the middle.
If the script says the speaker is relieved, the delivery should sound relieved, not like a showroom tour.
A price that changed this morning can be corrected in the editor before you export the file.
Restyle the on-screen line so the claim is easy to read on a phone, even in a noisy room.

items.t: Put Your Brand on the End Card
items.d: Add your logo, your colors, and your type so the last frame looks like the rest of the shop.
